channel.title: UNICEF Job Vacancies (Filtered)
channel.description: Filtered UNICEF job vacancies: Professional (P-1 to P-5), Director (D-1/D-2), internships and fellowships.

item.title: Fundraising Specialist (P-3), FT, #00136639, Quito-Ecuador, LACR
item.description: UNICEF Ecuador is looking for a Fundraising Specialist to lead our private sector fundraising strategy, build meaningful partnerships, and inspire businesses, donors, and supporters to create lasting impact for every child. The position is leading all UNICEF fundraising from the private sector and supporting broader engagement with business and key influencers in the private sector. Under the general guidance of the Representative, the position will be responsible for the overall coordination, planning, development and realization of the country office’s private sector fundraising strategy, in line with UNICEF’s global private sector strategy.

item.title: Internship - Social Protection, Colombo, Sri Lanka, 16 weeks (Full time), req no 594990
item.description:
Under the guidance and supervision of the Social Policy Officer (social protection), the intern will support the Social Policy section in the implementation of ongoing programme activities and policy engagement processes.
The internship aims to provide practical experience in social protection, public finance for children, and evidence generation, while contributing to UNICEF's efforts to strengthen child-sensitive social protection systems and social sector investments. The intern will support programme coordination, stakeholder engagement, research, data analysis, knowledge management, and event organization related to key social policy initiatives.

item.title: Executive Specialist, P-3, Temporary Position, 364 days, Dhaka, Bangladesh, #00138239
item.description: 🚀 Drive Strategic Impact for Children from the Office of the Representative. The Executive Specialist (P-3) will serve as a trusted strategic advisor and key partner to the Representative and Senior Management Team, supporting informed decision-making and effective delivery of UNICEF Bangladesh’s Country Programme. The role brings together strategic planning, executive support, policy advocacy, stakeholder engagement and high-level communications, working across the Country Office, government, UN and external partners. The incumbent will help translate strategic priorities into action, navigate complexity, ensure timely follow-up and strengthen organizational effectiveness, collaboration and innovation. This is a unique opportunity for a strategic thinker and strong relationship builder to contribute to national policy dialogue, organizational strategy and meaningful results for children across Bangladesh.

item.title: Staff Counsellor, P-4, Fixed Term Position, Kabul, Afghanistan, #00132067
item.description: Join us at UNICEF Afghanistan as the Staff Counsellor who promotes staff mental health, psychosocial wellbeing, resilience, and psychological safety. Through strategic advice to leadership, organizational wellbeing initiatives, individual and group support, and emergency psychosocial response, the position helps mitigate psychosocial risks, strengthen workforce resilience, enhance staff engagement and retention, and foster a healthy, inclusive, and productive work environment. This role supports operational continuity and organizational effectiveness by enabling staff and teams to perform sustainably in a challenging and high-risk context

item.title: Senior Programme Manager, P-5, Fixed Term Position, #00138037, Kandahar, Afghanistan
item.description: UNICEF is seeking an experienced and strategic Senior Programme Manager to lead its Polio Programme in Southern Afghanistan, the country's highest-risk region for poliovirus transmission. Based in the Southern Region, the incumbent will provide overall leadership, coordination, and oversight of polio eradication efforts, working closely with local authorities, WHO, humanitarian partners, and communities.The role will drive implementation of polio eradication strategies, strengthen integration with routine immunization, nutrition, and primary health services, and represent UNICEF at the Regional Emergency Operations Center (REOC). The position is responsible for policy dialogue, advocacy, programme quality assurance, monitoring and evaluation, and ensuring achievement of regional and national polio programme goals.This is a critical leadership position that contributes directly to Afghanistan’s and the global community’s efforts to eradicate polio by 2029, while advancing UNICEF’s commitment to equity and the rights of every child.

item.title: Senior Adviser Social & Behavior Change (RCCE), P-5, TA (6 Months), #138245, Bunia, Democratic Republic of Congo - WCAR
item.description: The Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) is responding to its 17th Ebola Virus Disease (EVD) outbreak, confirmed in May 2026 and affecting Ituri, North Kivu, and South Kivu provinces. The situation remains complex and evolving, with transmission occurring in both community and health-care settings. Response efforts are led by national authorities in a context shaped by health system limitations, logistical constraints, insecurity, displacement, and diverse community perceptions influencing health-seeking behaviors. UNICEF supports the Government through a multi-sectoral approach, focusing on community engagement, surveillance, infection prevention, and the continuity of essential services for vulnerable populations. This context requires strong coordination, adaptability, and cultural sensitivity to support effective and equitable response efforts, particularly for children and at-risk communities.

item.title: Social & Behavior Change Specialist (RCCE), P-4, TA (6 months), #00138149, Yambio, South Sudan, ESAR
item.description: The RCCE Specialist will lead risk communication and community engagement for BVD/Ebola preparedness and response across Yambio Field Office's high-risk counties (Yambio, Tambura, Maridi and surrounding areas), ensuring that communities have access to accurate, timely information; that two-way feedback and rumour-management UNICEF SOUTH SUDAN 2 mechanisms function and are acted on; and that community actors are active partners in surveillance, prevention and response, rather than passive recipients of messaging. Under the direct supervision of the Chief of Field Office, Yambio, and with a matrix reporting relationship for technical guidance to the Chief of Social and Behaviour Change (SBC) and Emergency Health, UNICEF South Sudan Country Office and in close collaboration with Health, WASH, Education and Child Protection colleagues, the National Public Health Institute (NPHI), the state Ministry of Health, WHO, and other partners, the RCCE Specialist will lead BVD/Ebola RCCE planning and delivery, strengthen the hotline and community based surveillance feedback loops, and build the capacity of frontline workers and volunteers and government counterparts to strengthen community structures/platforms and networks for disease outbreak preparedness; this includes travel to high-risk counties and points of entry.

item.title: WASH Specialist (IPC), P-3, TA (6 months), #00138147, Yambio, South Sudan, ESAR
item.description: UNICEF seeks a highly qualified WASH/IPC Specialist to be based in Yambio to lead and coordinate Ebola preparedness and response interventions across Western Equatoria, working closely with government authorities, WHO, health partners, and humanitarian actors to strengthen IPC and WASH readiness in high-risk locations. Therefore the purpose of the post will be under the direct technical supervision of the Chief of WASH and matrix technical coordination with Emergency Health team and daily administrative supervision of the Chief of UNICEF field office in Yambio, the WASH/IPC Specialist will provide strategic leadership and technical oversight for Ebola preparedness and readiness plan implementation and in case there will be any suspected/confirmed case during this assignment s/he will lead on response interventions focused on IPC and WASH. The incumbent will support preparedness and response activities in health facilities, Infectious Disease Units (IDUs), communities, points of entry and high-risk border locations, ensuring alignment with national preparedness plans, WHO guidance and UNICEF emergency response approaches. The position will strengthen health system readiness, reduce transmission risks, improve protection of health workers and communities, and enhance cross-border preparedness coordination in Western Equatoria State. Frequent travel to high-risk counties, border areas and points of entry will be required.

item.title: Administrative Specialist (Field Support & Construction), P-3, Fixed Term Position, Division of Financial and Administrative Management, O/p Brussels, Belgium #00014042
item.description:
The Administrative Specialist (Field Support & Construction) provides integrated administrative and technical support to field and regional offices. The role encompasses premises leasing, space utilization, property and construction management, as well as common premises projects.
The position ensures compliance with UNICEF policies on premises management, UN standards for space utilization, and financial accountability requirements (IPSAS 43) related to lease premises. It also supports the delivery of safe, cost-effective, and inclusive workplaces across all UNICEF offices.

item.title: Monitoring Officer, P-2, Temporary Position, 364 days, Supply Division, Copenhagen, Denmark, #00138107
item.description: The Monitoring Officer will support the global LMSM initiative with a particular focus on ensuring CO adoption and continued use, as well as institutionalization of the solution.

item.title: WASH Cluster Coordinator (Manager), P-4, Fixed Term, 12 Months, #114137, Kyiv, Ukraine, ECAR
item.description: Working in partnership with Cluster participants, the WASH Cluster Coordinator (Manager) provides leadership and representation for the Cluster. This contributes to the predictability and accountability of humanitarian action, in line with the aims of the cluster approach and IASC principles, and ensures that the humanitarian response is well-coordinated, strategic, adequate, coherent, effective and builds the resilience of the affected population. It also contributes to maintaining and enhancing the credibility and ability of UNICEF to fulfil its commitments as Cluster Lead Agency, in line with the CCCs. By identifying opportunities from the onset and throughout the humanitarian response to build resilience of the affected population, for programming and coordination capacity and leadership, the WASH Cluster Coordinator (Manager) also contributes to a smooth phasing out of the internationally led Cluster Leadership.

item.title: Logistics Specialist, P-3, Fixed Term Position, South Sudan, Juba, #00049137 (subject to classification)
item.description: Under the direct supervision of the Senior Supply & Logistics Manager, the Logistics Specialist coordinates and provides technical oversight for logistics, warehousing and distribution operations for UNICEF South Sudan Country Office. The role supports the effective movement, storage and delivery of supplies across the country programme and emergency response, including inbound shipment coordination, customs clearance, warehousing, inventory management, transport planning, last-mile distribution and logistics contract management. The Logistics Specialist works closely with supply, programme, operations, field office colleagues, government counterparts, implementing partners and service providers to ensure timely, efficient, accountable and fit-for-purpose logistics support for results for children

item.title: Supply & Logistics Manager, P-4, Fixed Term Position, Addis Ababa, Ethiopia #00137688
item.description: UNICEF is looking for a seasoned professional who will be responsible for managing the supply chains of a medium-to-large-sized country office, and/or medium sized emergency response operation. The supply chain operations include planning, procurement, contracting, customs clearance, warehousing, in country transport and distribution, as well as monitoring of supplies, services and construction works. The incumbent collaborates closely with programmes in defining supply interventions to meet programmatic needs and achieve results for children, and provides technical and advisory support to governments, national systems and partners on supply chain management. If you have the required profile, you are highly encouraged to apply. Taking up this assignment is motivating and rewarding.

item.title: Deputy Representative Operations, (P-5), Fixed-Term, Manila, Philippines #49276
item.description: A challenging and exciting opportunity has arisen within UNICEF Philippines Country Office for a passionate and committed Deputy Representative, Operations at the P-5 level. The Operations function supports the Head of the Office on managing the office and monitoring operations and programmes as needed, while providing advice on best and innovative management practices to enhance office performance. The function is a strategic Business Partner role within the Senior Management team, assuring the best use of UNICEF assets in alignment with sound management practices, office priorities and goals to deliver results for children.

item.title: Programme Manager, P-4, TA (364 days), #138145, Maiduguri (Borno), Nigeria - WCAR
item.description: Maiduguri office is seeking for a Programme Manager who will be responsible for executing a broad variety of tasks and primiliarily serves as Resilience Lead, coordinating resilience and durable solutions programmes for UNICEF Field Office in Northeast Nigeria based in Maiduguri, Borno State.

item.title: Procurement Officer, P-2, Temporary Position, Copenhagen, 364 days, Supply Division, #00138115
item.description: The Global Procedures and Guidance Documents (GPGD) project is a major regulatory reform initiative led by SD/QAPC/PSU. It aims to transition UNICEF’s Supply Regulatory Framework from a document-centric structure to a lifecycle-based, integrated architecture composed of six clusters and three layers (procedure, guidance, tools). This transformation responds to structural challenges in the current framework, including fragmentation, complex navigation, and limited alignment with operational workflows across country, regional and headquarters levels. The project is implemented over a defined timeline leading to Regulatory Framework resubmission

item.title: Digital Communication Officer (U-Report - Data - Officer) (P-2), Temporary Appointment, 6 Months Parental leave coverage, #00138116, Division of Global Communication and Advocacy, Valencia, Spain, (Remote)
item.description: Join UNICEF's Youth Engagement Team and help turn young people's voices into action. As a Digital Communication Officer (U-Report Data Officer), you will support U-Report, UNICEF's flagship digital engagement platform, by generating insights from real-time data, monitoring trends in youth participation, and producing evidence that informs advocacy and programme decisions worldwide. Your work will help strengthen UNICEF's ability to listen to, collaborate with, and empower young people as champions for children's rights and positive change in their communities

item.title: 2 National Interns, Child Protection (Child Justice, Ending Violence Against Children (EVAC) and Communications) UNICEF Libya, Tripoli, Libya Duration: 6 Months (Office-Based)
item.description: Join UNICEF Libya as a Child Protection Intern. Support efforts to strengthen child protection and child justice systems and contribute to initiatives focused on ending violence against children (EVAC), advocacy, and communications, helping to advance the rights and well-being of children across Libya

item.title: Chief Social & Behavior Change, (P-4), FT, #096672, Yaound - Republic of Cameroon, WCAR
item.description: Are you passionate about designing, managing and leading impactful Social and Behavioral Change strategies that advance children’s rights and strengthen community engagement? If so, this opportunity is for you.

item.title: Health Specialist (Emergency), P-4, Fixed Term Position, Kabul, Afghanistan, #00138034
item.description: UNICEF is seeking an experienced Health Specialist (Emergency) to lead and support emergency health programming for vulnerable women and children across Afghanistan. Reporting to the Chief of Health, the position plays a critical role in emergency preparedness, outbreak response, programme management, health systems strengthening, and coordination with government, UN agencies, NGOs, donors, and Health Cluster partners.

item.title: Deputy Representative Programme, P-5, Freetown, Sierra Leone Fixed-Term #1657
item.description: A challenging and exciting opportunity has arisen within UNICEF Sierra Leonne Country Office for a passionate and committed Deputy Representative Programme at the P-5 level. The Deputy Representative reports to the CO Representative for general supervision and direction. The Deputy Representative serves as the principal adviser on the overall management of the CO, development of CO policies and strategies; and under delegated authority, for coordinating and managing all phases of the Country Office Programme, from formulation to delivery of results in accordance with UNICEF’s Strategic Plans, standards of performance and accountability framework, ethics, and integrity.

item.title: Senior Supply & Logistics Specialist, P-5, Fixed Term Position, Supply Division, Copenhagen, Denmark, #00023287
item.description: The ability of the Senior Supply and Logistics Manager to successfully advise and provide critical remote and physical support to emergency responses directly impacts on UNICEF’s ability to deliver results of children in complex emergency contexts. This in turn contributes to maintaining/enhancing the credibility of UNICEF as an effective and responsible manager of funds entrusted to the organization and to furthering UNICEF image as a competent organization for delivering cost effective and sustainable program results for children.

item.title: Nutrition Manager, P-4, Fixed Term Position, #00108531, Manila, Philippines, EAPR
item.description: Join UNICEF Philippines to lead one of UNICEF's largest and innovative nutrition programmes in the Region. Reporting to the Chief of Health and Nutrition, you will provide strategic and technical leadership to strengthen maternal and child nutrition, address all forms of malnutrition, including the growing burden of overweight and obesity, and support government-led systems strengthening.

item.title: Chief Admin/Finance, P-4, FT, #00010180, New Delhi, India - APR
item.description: The Chief, Admin and Finance reports to the Deputy Representative, Operations (DRO) for general direction and guidance. The Chief is responsible for providing support to the DRO in managing monitoring and overseeing the full range of financial and administrative services in support of program and operational activities (i.e. financial planning, disbursements of funds and payments, treasury and accounting, financial analysis and reporting of resources, transport. travel and premises management, protocol administration), ensuring compliance of all financial and administrative operations with organizational plans, policies, procedures, guidelines, standards of performance, ethics and integrity.As the manager and functional expert of financial and administrative management services ln a large country office with thirteen field offices, the incumbent is accountable for provision of managerial leadership and policy guidance for achievement of effective service management and staff capacity development. Ensures management of staff for cost effective, quality and efficient administrative and financial operations in support of office operations and the country programmes.The Chief, Admin and Finance, when supervising support staff, will be responsible for planning and guiding work in progress and for reviewing work completed by subordinate staff to verify accuracy and compliance with Internal Public Sector Accounting Standards (IPSAS), UNICEF Financial Regulations and Rules, policies, procedures, guidelines, standards of accountability and ethics.The role focuses on upstream engagement through systems strengthening, strategic partnerships, governance, and advancing UNICEF's 3Cs for Every Child approach—Convene, Converge, and Catalyze—to achieve sustainable improvements in administrative and financial management outcomes at scale.

item.title: Consultoría - Actualización y Modernización del Plan Nacional para la Prevención, Detección Temprana, Control y Erradicación de la Influenza Aviar en Honduras bajo el Enfoque “Una Salud”, Tegucigalpa, Honduras (Remoto)#593485
item.description: UNICEF está buscando un Consultor/a para actualizar y modernizar integralmente el Plan Nacional para la Prevención, Detección Temprana, Control y Erradicación de la Influenza Aviaria en Honduras (2007) bajo estándares técnicos internacionales, integrando el enfoque multisectorial "Una Salud".

item.title: Chief Nutrition, P-5, Fixed Term Position, #00020954, Nairobi, Kenya
item.description: The Chief, Nutrition reports to the Deputy Representative for general guidance and direction. The Chief is responsible for managing and supervising all stages of the nutrition programme, from strategic planning and formulation to delivery of results. The Chief is also responsible for leading and managing the Nutrition team, along with strong collaboration with the Health and WASH sections on CSD imperatives, and other sections on cross-sectoral programmes. The Chief is accountable for ensuring that concrete and sustainable results in maternal, infant and child nutrition programmes are achieved in accordance with plans, allocation, results based-management approaches and methodology (RBM), as well as UNICEF’s Strategic Plans, standards of performance, and accountability framework.

item.title: Internal Audit Manager, P-4, TA, #00138077, Office of Internal Audit & Investigation, NYHQ, Home Based
item.description: The purpose of the Manager Digital Internal Audit Services is to advise on, facilitate, oversee, and coordinate implementation of the Digital audit strategy, assess digital risks and controls across UNICEF’s digital landscape, and manage the execution of digital audit engagements.

item.title: Immunization Specialist, (P-4), TA, #138255, (364 days), Mogadishu, Somalia, ESAR
item.description: The incumbent provides technical guidance and operational support throughout the programming process to facilitate the achievement of concrete and sustainable results, according to plans, allocation, results based-management approaches and methodology (RBM), organizational Strategic Plans and goals, standards of performance, and accountability framework ensuring immunization contributes to stronger PHC, resilient health systems, and improved health outcomes.

item.title: Procurement Services Manager, P-4, Fixed Term Position, Ethiopia, Addis Ababa, Ethiopia, #00096880
item.description: Join our team at UNICEF Ethiopia to manage the complex and large Procurement Services (PS) function.

item.title: Senior Advisor (Economic and Social Policy and Gender Equality), P-5, Fixed Term Position, Programme Group, #00133884
item.description: The Senior Advisor (Economic & Social Policy and Gender Equality) provides strategic leadership to integrate gender equality and adolescent girls' empowerment into economic and social policies, particularly in areas like child poverty reduction and social protection. Through policy advisory, thought leadership, capacity building, and accountability to the Gender Action Plan, the role ensures gender-sensitive approaches are embedded across UNICEF’s programming and partnerships.
